_source: Curriculum Development Centre Teaching Module — "Geography Teaching Module Form 1 - Term 2" (https://library.cdcrepository.info/resource.php?id=292). Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses (Term 2) — other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: General competences were specified at the main topic level in the module (e.g., Analytical thinking, Citizenship, Collaboration, Environmental Sustainability), but because the schema specifies competencies under sub-topics, only the sub-topic specific competences were included in the array. Note that heading numbering formats vary slightly across subtopics (e.g., SUB-TOPIC 1.1.1 vs 1.1.2 SUB-TOPIC 2), and the sample lesson plan at the end of the text references topic numbers 1.4/1.4.1 which contradict the body numbering.

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 1.1. TOPIC 1: NATURAL RESOURCES
topics.description: Natural resources are materials like water, air, trees, and minerals essential for life that come from nature. This topic explores the responsible use of natural resources, the relationship between population and resources, and sustainable management practices.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC 1.1.1: NATURAL RESOURCES
sub_topics.description: Explores renewable and non-renewable natural resources, their identification, classification, and responsible utilization to prevent depletion.

competencies.description: Use renewable and non-renewable resources responsibly

sub_topics.name: 1.1.2. SUB-TOPIC 2: POPULATION AND NATURAL RESOURCES
sub_topics.description: Examines the dynamic relationship between population growth and natural resource demand, including overconsumption, environmental degradation, and sustainable management practices.

competencies.description: Analyze the relationship between population and natural resources

sub_topics.name: 1.1.3. SUB-TOPIC 3: SUSTAINABLE MANAGEMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCE.
sub_topics.description: Focuses on balancing human needs with environmental protection through conservation, restoration, and sustainable management practices.

competencies.description: Practise sustainable management of natural resources

topics.name: 2.1. TOPIC 2: POPULATION
topics.description: Population studies or demography scientifically investigates human populations, focusing on size, structure, distribution, and dynamics. This topic covers population composition, distribution, rapid population growth, and migration.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1. SUB –TOPIC 1: POPULATION COMPOSITION
sub_topics.description: Covers population traits such as age, gender, density, and structure, as well as the interpretation and construction of population pyramids.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2. SUB-TOPIC 2: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN ZAMBIA
sub_topics.description: Analyzes patterns, trends, and natural, social, economic, and political factors influencing population distribution across Zambia using maps and GIS tools.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.3. SUB – TOPIC 3: RAPID POPULATION GROWTH IN ZAMBIA
sub_topics.description: Examines the causes, effects, potential benefits, and actionable solutions related to rapid population growth in Zambia.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.4. SUB-TOPIC 4: MIGRATION
sub_topics.description: Investigates concepts, types, causes, and impacts of internal and international migration on places of origin and destination.

competencies.description: Apply knowledge of migration in aspects of daily life
